title: SREV-053 DNS filter begin constructor boundary contract

lookup_state.description: Constructed WSA_LOOKUP state stored in WSA_LookupMap

contracts: WSALookupServiceBeginW returns only a handle used by later WSALookupServiceNext calls
The filtered path requires a non-null lphLookup before publishing a fake lookup handle
WSA_LOOKUP state owns DomainName and optional ServiceClassId before the fake handle crosses to the caller
A fake lookup handle crosses the API boundary only after DomainName, optional ServiceClassId, Namespace, and entries or NoMore state are initialized
Allocation failure returns SOCKET_ERROR with WSA_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY and removes any inserted WSA_LookupMap state
